title: Face Filler for Cheeks, Jawline & Chin: A Doctor's Guide
h1: Face filler for cheeks, jawline and chin: a doctor's guide
desc: How face filler restores volume and contour in the cheeks, jawline, chin and under-eyes, which product suits which area, how long it lasts and prices in Dubai Marina.
answer: Face filler is a hyaluronic acid gel that a doctor places to restore volume and shape: fuller cheeks, a sharper jawline and chin and fresher under-eyes. Results are immediate and usually last 9 to 18 months. At Skin & Laser, Juvederm, Teosyal and Stylage cost AED 1,950 + VAT, Skinfill AED 900 + VAT and a liquid face lift (5 to 7 ml) AED 7,000 + VAT.
body:
As we age, the face loses volume and support. Cheeks flatten, the jawline softens and the under-eyes look hollow. Face filler replaces some of that lost volume, and done well it looks like you, just fresher.

## What is face filler?

Modern face fillers are made of hyaluronic acid, a sugar found naturally in the skin that holds water. A doctor places the gel with a fine needle or cannula at the right depth. Firmer gels go deep on the bone to build structure; softer gels sit closer to the surface for smooth lines. Over time the body breaks it down naturally, and it can be dissolved with an enzyme if needed.

## Which area needs what?

- **Cheeks:** restoring cheek volume lifts the mid-face and softens nose-to-mouth lines.
- **Jawline and chin:** a firmer gel defines the jaw and balances the profile. Our Texas treatment uses 3 ml of Teosyal Ultra Deep for strong structure.
- **Under-eyes:** a soft gel fills a hollow tear trough. We call this Light eyes.
- **Whole face:** a liquid face lift uses 5 to 7 ml across several areas in one plan.

See all options and prices on our [face filler page](/treatments/face-filler-dubai/).

## Which product?

Juvederm, Teosyal and Stylage are premium ranges with gels for every area. Skinfill is a quality option at a lower price. Your doctor chooses the gel by area, depth and the result you want, not by brand alone.

## Filler or laser lifting?

Filler restores volume and shape. If your main concern is loose or crepey skin rather than lost volume, an energy treatment may suit you better, such as [Nd:YAG laser lifting](/treatments/laser-skin-tightening-dubai/). Many patients combine both. Browse our [face contouring treatments](/face-contouring-dubai/).

## What to expect

Numbing cream is applied first, and most fillers also contain a local anaesthetic. Mild swelling and small bruises can last a few days. Avoid heat, intense exercise and alcohol for 24 hours. We review your result after about two weeks.

## Prices in Dubai Marina

At Skin & Laser Juvederm, Teosyal and Stylage cost AED 1,950 + VAT, Skinfill AED 900 + VAT, Texas AED 2,900 + VAT, Light eyes AED 1,200 + VAT and a liquid face lift AED 7,000 + VAT.
